answer: A sybil farm would need to forge a fresh stamp per fake identity, so costs spiral with every clone, making mass registration economically irrational. Each agent must burn a unique proof-of-work stamp tied to its identity, and peers verify it against the epoch seed. Agents that skip this become hollow shells with no attested history and get ignored by peers. This binds identity to real compute, not free signups. In practice, sa0037 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
